# AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 source pin

Source: https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR
Revision: `a21ffb8f6c13233ba336352bdff293894c706575` (tag `v1.0.2`)

Vendored upstream files: `ffx_a.h`, `ffx_fsr1.h`, and the complete upstream `license.txt`.
The host-side Magpie scalar implementation is a documented CPU reference port of the FSR 1 EASU and RCAS equations. It is not an AMD-produced CPU implementation. Keep this notice and the upstream MIT license with redistributed copies.
